claim: Boris Cherny created the modern Claude Code product but built on earlier Anthropic coding-RL, harness, and clide work.
The direct Claude Code prototype began in 2024 as a new standalone Claude CLI built to explore agentic coding through the public API.
The product's core architecture is a thin agent harness in which the model gathers context, chooses tools, acts, verifies, and iterates.
Skills, MCP, hooks, and subagents are complementary layers for on-demand knowledge, external access, deterministic control, and context isolation.
Claude Code product direction is driven by dogfooding, user feedback, telemetry, latent demand, enterprise constraints, and expected near-future model capabilities.
The team moves quickly on prototypes and fixes but maintains a high bar for net-new features and now applies stronger public-build dogfooding, evaluations, soak periods, and gradual rollouts.
